QF.id: VII Introduction to Securities Broking Operations_44

question.text: The post-close market trading session operates between:

explanation.text: The Logic: Post-close market timing is 3:40 PM to 4:00 PM. Only market orders are allowed in this session, and matching is at a single price based on the close price. The Trap: There is a gap between normal market close (3:30 PM) and the start of the post-close session at 3:40 PM, when the closing price is calculated. Note: The T+1 session table reiterates the same 3:40 PM to 4:00 PM timing.
